heroSummary: Moore Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Thursday, Aug. 13, 2026, and the last day for students is Friday, May 21, 2027. Thanksgiving Break runs Nov. 23–27, Winter Break runs Dec. 21–Jan. 1, and Spring Break runs March 15–19. Students are also out Monday, Jan. 4, for Record Day, so classes resume Tuesday, Jan. 5.

calendarNotes: Teachers report August 10 and students report August 13. The PDF lists 175 instructional days and seven professional days; its 182 total combines those categories rather than counting 182 student days. September 21 is an In-service day with no school. October 14 is a no-school conference morning followed by Fall Break October 15–16; the live calendar separately lists evening conferences October 13. Winter Break ends January 1, January 4 is Record Day, and students return January 5. February 15 is labeled TNT Day and shaded as a teacher professional day; MPS does not explain what TNT stands for. March 12 is another no-school conference day immediately before Spring Break. The last student day is May 21, followed by Record Day May 24.

customSections.label: Why the MPS Calendar Shows 182 Days
customSections.content: The 182 shown on the MPS calendar does not mean students attend school for 182 days. It combines 175 instructional days with seven professional days.

table.caption: Published MPS 2026–27 day totals
table.footnote: The Oct. 14 conference day is a student no-school day. March 12 is shaded as a Teacher Professional Day and is included in the second semester's three professional days. May 24 is a Record Day after the last student day and is not part of the printed 182-day total.

customSections.label: How Weather Can Change the Moore Calendar
customSections.content: Oklahoma requires students to complete 1,086 instructional hours. MPS checks its banked minutes before deciding whether missed time must be made up. ParentSquare is the district's primary notification source, and MPS aims to announce cancellations by 6 a.m.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Moore students return after Winter Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ends Friday, January 1, and Monday, January 4, is Record Day. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Moore students off for Parent/Teacher Conferences?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out Wednesday, October 14, 2026, and Friday, March 12, 2027. The live calendar also lists evening conferences October 13 from 4:30–7:00 p.m.; that evening session is not another full no-school day.

calendarFaqs.q: What is TNT Day on the Moore calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: February 15 is labeled TNT Day and shaded as a teacher professional day, so students are out. MPS does not explain what TNT stands for, so we keep the district's label rather than guessing.
